non_descending_object: The single-outcome selection predicate (a 'which-branch-is-actual' indexical distinction). STATEMENT: a predicate sel : (post-interaction global quantum state) -> (one definite realized pointer value), i.e. the map from the decohered DIAGONAL ENSEMBLE (an improper mixture: an environment-entangled superposition the apparatus cannot internally read as a classical 'or') to a SINGLE realized outcome (a proper classical fact, one branch actualized). This is the residue left after the three corroborating edges peel off everything QM + named imports CAN supply. WHY IN NEITHER Sigma_f: QM's Sigma_f (per the frozen QM card) contains expectation values <A>, energy spectra, transition/measurement PROBABILITIES (the diagonal Born weights), and the diagonal classical distribution -- it contains the WEIGHTS over outcomes but NOT a selection of one. The diagonal density matrix E(rho) produced by the dephasing closure is EXACTLY idempotent (ID=0) and identical whether one outcome is realized or all coexist: 'which branch is actual' is a fiber-constant-VIOLATING distinction that the diagonal lens f cannot resolve. measurement-outcome (the readout) inherits QM's Sigma_f verbatim (observable_readout, no fresh casting), so the selection predicate is in NEITHER endpoint's Sigma_f. It is the non-descending object: not expressible in either layer's vocabulary, and (per the B.2 non-factorization witness below) two QM-states identical in Sigma_f are distinguished by it. NON-FACTORIZATION WITNESS (B.2): take the global post-measurement state |Psi> = sum_k c_k |s_k>|a_k>|env_k> (system-apparatus-environment, decohered: <env_j|env_k> ~ delta_jk). Two readouts a,b: (a) the FULL branching state |Psi> (universe retains all branches, e.g. many-worlds); (b) a state in which outcome k* has been SELECTED (only branch k* is actual). Both have the IDENTICAL reduced/diagonal density matrix rho_diag = sum_k |c_k|^2 |a_k><a_k| -- identical in QM's Sigma_f (same expectation values of every retained observable, same Born weights). L0_difference = 1 (the measurement-outcome native readout 'one definite a_{k*} is the fact' distinguishes a from b); D0_difference = 0 (QM's diagonal/expectation-value readouts are blind: rho_diag is the same). VERDICT: states identified by QM's lens (same in Sigma_f) are distinguished by the single-outcome predicate => pi_1 does not factor through pi_0; non-factorization holds. The selection distinction is NON-DEFINABLE FROM BELOW. This is the UP/emergence signature (B.2), consistent with the scored emergence-up modality.

casting_conditionality: GIVEN the FROZEN QM casting (the paper's dephasing-lens casting: Z = density matrices on truncated H_d; f = retain the diagonal in a chosen pointer basis; E = the exactly-idempotent dephasing channel; Born weights and pointer basis OUTSIDE Sigma_f by construction), the required missing-layer shape is the single-outcome selection predicate above. The casting is LOAD-BEARING: it is the dephasing lens that makes the diagonal ENSEMBLE (not a single outcome) the QM-native object, hence makes selection the residue. Under the alternative full-unitary/algebraic QM casting (casting_alternatives Alt-1: f = whole observable algebra, no coarse-graining), there is no diagonal-ensemble intermediate and the gap presents directly as 'unitary evolution never yields a definite pointer reading' -- SAME residue (single-outcome selection), reached more directly; the missing-layer shape is INVARIANT under this re-casting (not casting-fragile on the residue). WHAT IS CASTING-SENSITIVE (and downgraded per audit): the shape-A/B TYPING and its arrow -- shape B's shadow-down vs the scored emergence-up. DIVERGENCE-AS-CASTING-OFF reading: if one believed E032 SHOULD close, the candidate culprit would be that the dephasing casting under-reads QM by treating the improper mixture as a classical ensemble -- but the QM card EXPLICITLY flags off-diagonal/branch information as discarded by f and the Born map as a named import, so the casting is faithful and the gap is a genuine physics gap, NOT a casting artifact. Both readings reported; the faithful-casting reading is favored (the casting tracks the governing paper).
out_of_sample_test: PREDICTION not used to build the card: if shape A (richer-parent-above / objective-collapse family) is the correct missing layer, then ANY accepted future single-outcome theory must introduce a predicate that BREAKS the exact idempotence of QM's dephasing completion: specifically, the missing layer's completion endomap E_L must be NON-IDEMPOTENT on superpositions in a way that depends on a NEW staging parameter (a collapse rate / mass-threshold / gravitational scale) ABSENT from QM's D ledger -- i.e. L must add a small parameter to D that QM does not carry. CONVERSELY, if shape B (endpoint-is-shadow-of-substrate / many-worlds family), the missing layer adds NO new dynamical parameter to D and NO non-unitary term -- it adds ONLY a self-locating/indexical READOUT predicate to Sigma_f while leaving QM's E and D bit-for-bit unchanged. STRUCTURAL DISCRIMINATOR (the out-of-sample test): examine whether a proposed selection layer modifies QM's DEFECT LEDGER D (new staging parameter, non-unitary term) or only its READOUT algebra Sigma_f. A layer that modifies D is shape A; a layer that modifies only Sigma_f is shape B. This was NOT used to build the card (built from the three corroborating edges' residue, not from D/Sigma_f modification analysis), and it makes a sharp, checkable structural prediction about where in the closure package (Z,f,Sigma_f,E,D) any future single-outcome theory MUST and MUST NOT touch -- a no-fitting prediction the atlas can later score against any concrete proposal (e.g. CSL would be confirmed-shape-A by adding a noise-field parameter to D; a derived-Born-weight MWI measure would be confirmed-shape-B by touching only Sigma_f). HONEST NOVELTY CAVEAT (audit): this discriminator is genuinely out-of-sample and falsifiable, but is partly a structural RE-STATEMENT of the collapse-modifies-dynamics vs MWI-only-reinterprets folklore -- the honest novelty is the closure-package LOCATION of the touch-point, not the dichotomy itself. The witness asserts this cannot happen; that is the card's standing risk.

audit.verdict: CONTESTED / CASTING-DEPENDENT on the value-add; FIRM on the core residue-location. The card's STRUCTURAL MATCH with convention (single-outcome selection as the residue after decoherence E006, weights E007, basis E026 are peeled off) is correct, well-evidenced, and honestly labeled as a match -- this much survives. CONTENT OVERCLAIM is genuinely avoided: the card is scrupulous about 'shape not content' and never names the missing theory. The OUT-OF-SAMPLE test (does a future selection theory touch the D ledger or only Sigma_f) is genuine, falsifiable, non-circular, and the card's strongest element. The claimed DIVERGENCE / value-add -- typing collapse vs MWI as two STRUCTURAL shapes (richer-parent-above shape A vs shadow-of-substrate shape B) and certifying the atlas cannot select -- holds only PARTIALLY and is materially a casting artifact: (1) it relabels the existing collapse-vs-MWI dichotomy rather than producing a new distinction (textbook-in-costume, primer s3/s9), and (2) shape B is labeled shadow-DOWN while the edge is scored emergence-UP, so the asserted under-determination straddles both arrows and the arrow is casting-/shape-dependent -- a symptom of a casting artifact and an unaudited down-descent claim riding under an up scored modality (s6/s9-trap-5 violation). The card honestly self-grades 'partial' and refuses a world-changing claim, so this is NOT a motivated-overreach sold as discovery; it is an over-elevation of a largely-confirmatory result whose distinctive shape-typing is casting-sensitive. The E3 (not E0) foreclosure is correctly conservative (no constructible run-object asserted) and the (emergence-up, E3) pair is rubric-legal. NET: keep the residue-decomposition and the D-vs-Sigma_f test as the defensible core; demote the 'two structural shapes' framing to casting-dependent/relabeling and resolve the arrow inconsistency before any field-redirecting claim. Not field-redirecting as written; defensible as a disciplined re-location of the measurement-problem residue.
